# Tauri Universal

> Agent-native Tauri and web application building blocks for React, Vue, Svelte, and React Native Web.

Use the catalog before searching source. Retrieve only the documentation page needed for the current task.

## Agent entry points

- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): mandatory safety and implementation rules
- [Capability catalog](agent/catalog.json): query with `pnpm agent find <capability>`
- [Efficiency baseline](agent/evals.md): repeatable tasks and measurements

## Capability matrix

Framework support per catalog capability. Query details with `pnpm agent inspect <id-or-symbol>`.

- ui.accordion (component): react, native
- ui.badge (component): react, native
- ui.button (component): react, native
- ui.card (component): react, native
- ui.checkbox (component): react, native
- ui.dialog (component): react, native
- ui.dropdown-menu (component): react, native
- ui.input (component): react, native
- ui.label (component): react, native
- ui.popover (component): react, native
- ui.select (component): react, native
- ui.separator (component): react, native
- ui.skeleton (component): react, native
- ui.switch (component): react, native
- ui.table (component): react, native
- ui.tabs (component): react, native
- ui.textarea (component): react, native
- ui.tooltip (component): react, native
- block.data-table (block): react, vue, svelte
- block.form (block): react, vue, svelte
- block.form-dialog (block): react, vue, svelte
- block.app-shell (block): react, vue, svelte
- block.page-container (block): react, vue, svelte
- core.form-schema (contract): core
- core.table (contract): core
- core.query-keys (contract): core
- bridge.todo-storage (bridge): universal

## Documentation

- [Introduction](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/index.mdx): Documentation for the Universal Todos app.
- [Agent Guide](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/agent.mdx): Compact discovery, implementation, and verification paths for coding agents working in this monorepo.
- [Getting Started](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/getting-started.mdx): Set up the project locally and start developing.
- [Architecture](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/architecture.mdx): How the monorepo and shared packages fit together.
- [Pro Core](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/pro-core.mdx): The framework-free contracts behind every pro component — form schemas, column DSL, table features, and query keys.
  - Blocks
  - [Blocks](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/index.mdx): Ant Design Pro-style feature blocks on shadcn primitives and TanStack engines — data table, forms, and layouts.
  - [ProDataTable](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/pro-data-table.mdx): Toolbar, table, and pagination over TanStack Table — client or server mode.
  - [ProForm](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/pro-form.mdx): Schema-driven form over TanStack Form with validation, groups, and submit states.
  - [ProFormDialog](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/pro-form-dialog.mdx): ProForm inside a Dialog for create and edit flows.
  - [AppShell](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/app-shell.mdx): Application frame — sidebar navigation, header, and content area.
  - [PageContainer](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/blocks/page-container.mdx): Breadcrumb trail, title block, actions, and page body in a standard layout.
  - Components
  - [Accordion](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/accordion.mdx): A vertically stacked set of collapsible content panels, built on Radix UI.
  - [Badge](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/badge.mdx): Small status descriptor for UI elements, with six visual variants.
  - [Button](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/button.mdx): Primary interactive element, with variants, sizes, and asChild support.
  - [Card](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/card.mdx): Grouped container with header, title, description, content, and footer slots.
  - [Checkbox](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/checkbox.mdx): Binary input built on Radix UI with checked/indeterminate states.
  - [Dialog](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/dialog.mdx): Modal overlay built on Radix UI — alert and form dialogs.
  - [Dropdown Menu](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/dropdown-menu.mdx): Action list anchored to a trigger, built on Radix UI.
  - [Input](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/input.mdx): Single-line text field styled for the shared theme.
  - [Label](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/label.mdx): Form field caption linked to controls via htmlFor, built on Radix UI.
  - [Popover](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/popover.mdx): Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, built on Radix UI.
  - [Select](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/select.mdx): Single-value picker with typeahead, built on Radix UI.
  - [Separator](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/separator.mdx): Horizontal or vertical rule dividing content sections, built on Radix UI.
  - [Skeleton](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/skeleton.mdx): Loading placeholder that mirrors the shape of incoming content.
  - [Switch](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/switch.mdx): Toggle control for immediate on/off settings, built on Radix UI.
  - [Table](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/table.mdx): Styled table primitives — the base under the ProDataTable block.
  - [Tabs](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/tabs.mdx): Switch between panels within the same context, built on Radix UI.
  - [Textarea](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/textarea.mdx): Multi-line text field that grows with content.
  - [Tooltip](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/components/tooltip.mdx): Small informational popup on hover or focus, built on Radix UI.
  - Platforms
  - [Vue](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/platforms/vue.mdx): The pro blocks re-implemented as Vue SFCs — @package/pro-vue and the vue-playground.
  - [Svelte](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/platforms/svelte.mdx): The pro blocks re-implemented as Svelte components — @package/pro-svelte and the svelte-playground.
  - [React Native Web](apps/tauri-app/content/docs/platforms/react-native-web.mdx): The shared token base rendered through React Native primitives — ui-native, the playground, and the RN porting recipe.
